summary.text: Jamie Keenan-deVargas is the Democratic candidate for the Washington House of Representatives, District 22-Position 2, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Lisa Parshley.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a horticultural retail worker, a renter and an artist in Thurston County.

paragraphs.text: Jamie Keenan-deVargas earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Washington in 2026, and Ballotpedia lists his career experience as working in retail.
In his survey answers, Keenan-deVargas said he supports statewide rent caps and free childcare and healthcare.
He also said he would limit the purchasing power of private equity firms in the housing market.
